# create_supergroup()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.create_supergroup`

## Signature

```python
async def create_supergroup(title: str, description: str = '') -> 'types.Chat': ...
```

## Documentation

Create a new supergroup.

> [!NOTE]
> If you want to create a new basic group, use [`create_group`](create_group.md) instead.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`title`** (`str`)
  The supergroup title.

- **`description`** (`str`, *optional*)
  The supergroup description.

### Returns

[`Chat`](../../types/user_and_chats/Chat.md): On success, a chat object is returned.

### Example

```python
await app.create_supergroup("Supergroup Title", "Supergroup Description")
```
